column3: Exact تقوى/obedience pairing; the clearest external parallel to the focus's closing two commands.
Isolates the protective تقوى appeal, sharpening one member of the three-command sequence.
Its patience-and-response scene supplies a secondary f02 lens on capacity to remain receptive to guidance.
Repeats the exact paired formula but adds little beyond the earlier 26:108 parallel.
Within the same sequence, it develops f03 by questioning the missing divine weight.
Another exact pair; its distinctive value is limited after the earlier 26 formulae.
A further exact pair, now substantially redundant with ranks 1, 4, and 6.
Continues the focus's immediate sequence into the forgiveness route associated with f01.
Makes exclusive worship explicit, supporting the focus's worship axis and f03 boundary.
An additional exact formula with little new evidence after the prior repetitions.
Shows the protected destination associated with تقوى, as a consequence rather than a command.
Adds an f02 distinction between responsive obedience, turning away, and practical capacity.
Pairs worship with تقوى and directly parallels the focus's first two commands.
Within the sequence, depicts refusal of the call and so supplies the f02 resistance contrast.
Pairs obedience with turning away and clarifies the messenger's bounded role.
Links تقوى to a sustained practice and an eventual gathering, extending the protective axis.
Adds the creation-stages setting that follows the command sequence, without repeating its terms.
Draws an explicit exclusive-worship boundary, strongly bearing on f01 and f03.
Closely parallels worship plus تقوى in a messenger's address to a people.
Frames redirected worship as a contrary command, clarifying the focus's exclusive worship direction.
Its treatment of Noah as servant adds a secondary authority-and-reception context.
Joins return, تقوى, and established practice while opposing divided allegiance.
Identifies the speaker immediately before the focus as a clear warner.
Maintains a firm non-equivalence between two worship orientations, supporting f03 by contrast.
Places the worship call in a divided communal response, adding a reception consequence.
Extends the same-surah sequence from forgiveness toward a material outcome.
Offers only an indirect secondary lens of guided protection; it does not echo the command triad.
Broadens the worship command into a universal messenger pattern and an avoidance boundary.
Supplies the f03 contrary pattern of seeking honor through rival deities.
Adds capacity-sensitive obedience and an alternative of turning away.
Restates the commanded exclusive worship and binds it to shared lordship and witness.
Documents the persistence of the call that the focus states in condensed form.
Supplies a divine-oneness frame for the worship direction, though it lacks the triad's action.
Adds a lordship-and-will frame that can underwrite the focus's authority structure.
Records flight after the call, a direct same-sequence contrast to f02 receptivity.
Offers a secondary development of تقوى as protective conduct; the contrast route remains only boundary evidence.
Yet another exact paired formula, largely redundant with the preceding 26 parallels.
No sufficiently localized link to worship, تقوى, or responsive obedience is provided.
Pairs obedience with turning away, giving a clear reception-versus-refusal contrast.
A repeated exact pair with minimal incremental evidence at this point.
Gives the immediate promised consequence of the focus's commands: forgiveness and a fixed term.
States exclusive worship under warning, but it is redundant with stronger worship-boundary cards.
Repeats the formula while its auxiliary evidence extends obedience toward measured social conduct.
Continues the same-surah account by specifying a public mode of the call.
Turns تقوى into a social boundary against public violation, extending f01 beyond abstraction.
Combines worship and تقوى in a close messenger-to-people parallel, though less complete than 29:16.
Reasserts exclusive worship and connects it to grateful orientation, strengthening f03.
Distinguishes messenger and audience responsibilities within the obedience relation.
A Noah-specific worship-plus-تقوى call, useful but partly redundant with 23:32 and 71:3.
Completes the same-surah sequence with the provision outcome following the call.
Explicitly joins تقوى and forgiveness as distinct protective routes, closely serving f01.
Uses the exact paired formula after clarification, but adds limited new evidence after the 26 series.
Provides the mission-and-warning frame that immediately leads into the focus.
Defines a contrary worship identity, retaining the f03 boundary without resolving the two orientations.
A further exclusive-worship call with little incremental value after numerous close parallels.
Adds confessed fault and a request for forgiveness, a secondary precursor to the same-surah forgiveness route.
Shows obedience directed to the wrong source as a reversal, sharpening f02 by contrast.
Adds Noah's protective warning for his people, but overlaps stronger Noah-call cards.
Carries the forgiveness request into an intercessory response, a secondary f01 parallel.
Links obedience to mercy, extending the outcome of responsive alignment.
Combines exclusive worship with forgiveness and return, though its route is less direct than 71:10.
No localized evidence connects inheritance of the garden to the focus's command triad.
Makes exclusive worship portable across place, a secondary f03 development.
Repeats the exact paired formula in a messenger setting, with limited novelty.
Offers a forgiveness petition but no direct worship, تقوى, or obedience link.
Provides only a broad authority frame, not a localized parallel to the triad.
Adds worship and eschatological orientation but lacks the focus's protective or obedience terms.
Portrays recognition of divine and messenger promise as increased submission, a secondary f02 parallel.
Shows harmful obedience as reversal, preserving the contrary f02 reading.
Brings together تقوى, obedience, and communal repair, a substantial social extension of the focus.
No localized evidence ties its conflict scene to the focus's three commands.
Supplies a concise oneness frame for the worship direction, supporting f03.
Combines تقوى, hearing, obedience, and capacity, strongly developing f01 and f02 together.
Directs worship toward the Lord of the House, a compact secondary f03 parallel.
Extends divine lordship and protection into the inner direction of worship, supporting f03.
Connects warning and exclusive divinity to a direct تقوى command, though not the full triad.
No localized link to the focus's worship, protection, or obedience axes is supplied.
Provides divine oneness but is redundant with more developed oneness and worship-boundary cards.
Joins covenantal hearing and obedience with تقوى, a close communal parallel to the focus.
Its willing-versus-compelled response is strong f02 boundary evidence about obedience.
Rejects rival divinity and supports f03, but adds less than the more explicit worship cards.
Pairs worship with a concrete justice boundary, a useful but partial social extension.
No sufficiently localized connection to the command triad is available.
Offers an indirect oneness-and-gathering frame without a close action parallel.
Contains a worship call but is redundant with stronger messenger-call and boundary cards.
No localized evidence links the described outcome to the focus's commands.
Contrasts voluntary and compelled action, preserving a secondary f02 boundary.
Explicitly combines obedience, خشية, and تقوى in an outcome-bearing sequence.
Shows corrupted, induced obedience, a strong contrary reading for f02.
Extends the worship call to market justice but remains redundant with closer triad parallels.
No localized route connects the signs described here to the focus's command sequence.
Adds communal servant identity, but only indirectly bears on the worship command.
No sufficiently localized connection to worship, تقوى, or obedience is supplied.
Pairs messenger mediation with تقوى and repair before danger, a useful protective extension.
No localized evidence connects this legal-conflict scene to the focus's three commands.
Connects wrongful worship with collective accounting, supplying a consequence-side f03 contrast.
No localized evidence ties the inheritance rule to the focus's command triad.
Shows a garden outcome for the متقين, a secondary consequence of the protective axis.
No localized evidence ties the inheritance rule to the focus's command triad.
Links obedience with repair and forgiveness, a compact outcome-side synthesis of the focus.
States the exclusive worship orientation and dependence that ground the focus's first command.
Directly joins worship of the Lord with the prospective formation of تقوى.
Combines hearing, obedience, and forgiveness in a particularly close f01/f02 parallel.
Makes تقوى an all-encompassing communal imperative with a final-state boundary.
Connects obedience to God and messenger with an outcome, closely extending the focus's final command.
Supplies the contrary disobedience outcome, preserving a boundary rather than positive support.
Combines exclusive worship with a concrete social ethic, strongly extending f03 into conduct.
Directly orders obedience to God and messenger and frames disputed authority through return to them.
Explicitly identifies obedience to the messenger with obedience to God, clarifying the focus's addressee relation.
Makes justice proximate to تقوى and so gives the protective command a concrete public expression.
Pairs تقوى with seeking a means toward God and sustained striving.
Joins fear of God with hearing, a close receptive counterpart to the focus's command sequence.
Names the one God as creator and follows with direct worship, strongly supporting f03.
Links faith and تقوى with opened provision, closely paralleling the outcome sequence in 71:10-12.
Commands obedience to God and messenger while prohibiting turning away after hearing.
Frames response to God and messenger as a life-giving call, a close f02 reception parallel.
Gives a discriminating protective outcome for تقوى, extending f01.
Joins obedience to God and messenger with communal steadiness and non-dispute.
Supplies a direct f03 contrary pattern in which rival human authorities are elevated.
Combines تقوى with remaining among the truthful, extending protection into communal fidelity.
Makes exclusive worship the basis for an immediately social command structure.
Combines shared lordship, direct worship, and a straight-path framing.
Commands worship with perseverance in worship, strengthening the focus's sustained response axis.
Explicitly names God and commands worship with an established devotional practice.
Universalizes the exclusive-worship proclamation across the messenger pattern.
Distinguishes the God-directed value of ritual from externals by naming تقوى.
Links worship with embodied devotional acts and doing good, extending the focus into practice.
Contrasts a verbal claim of obedience with subsequent turning away, a direct f02 boundary.
Presents hearing and obedience as the responsive form of believing reception.
Directs worship to the Lord of the sanctuary, a compact exclusive-worship parallel.
Forbids obedience where it would compromise divine association, sharply defining f02's boundary.
Constrains believer choice once God and messenger decide, directly bearing on receptive obedience.
Supplies the retrospective contrary confession of obedience, preserving a warning-side f02 reading.
Pairs تقوى with rightly directed speech and leads immediately into the listed 33:71 outcome.
Provides the contrary worship boundary by prohibiting devotion to a hostile rival authority.
Records arrogant refusal at the proclamation of divine oneness, a direct f02/f03 contrast.
Commands worship with purified religious orientation, closely supporting f03.
Restates the command to worship God with purified orientation from the speaker's position.
Opposes worship of false authorities and identifies those who turn to God, an f03 boundary and return pattern.
Reiterates the exclusive-worship warning in a messenger setting, closely parallel to the focus.
Combines exclusive worship with warning of an approaching painful consequence.
Directly commands obedience to God and messenger and links it to preserving deeds.
Pairs deference to God and messenger with تقوى, a close authority-and-protection parallel.
States worship as the defining human and jinn orientation, grounding the focus's first command.
Concludes with prostration and worship of God, a concise embodied response parallel.
Combines تقوى with self-accounting before God, extending the protective command into reflection.
Links تقوى with a way out and provision, closely resonating with 71:10-12.
Uses the protective imperative for oneself and family against punishment, a direct f01 extension.
Sets obedience to God and messenger against disobedience and its consequence.
Combines exclusive worship, purified orientation, established practice, and almsgiving in a comprehensive parallel.
Explicitly rejects the rival worship object, completing the contrary boundary alongside listed 109:4-5.
Explicitly denies reciprocal worship identity, completing the contrary boundary alongside listed 109:4-5.
